messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Service pulse — monthly dashboard + QBR prep

Hi team,

Attached is the August service pulse (attachment) — distilled dashboard for leadership and the QBR. Wanted to call out the signals I'm most worried about and what I think should be in the leadership slide deck:

Key signals (30-day rolling):
- Latency: p95 = 220ms (up 8% MoM). Tail is concentrated on hosted text-generation routes, primarily sequences >1024.
- Cost: unit cost per 1M tokens = $280 (down 6% MoM) — quantization & batching improvements paying off on average.
- Uptime: 99.95% (SLA met; two brief infra incidents on 8/03 that auto-failed over).
- Usage: API requests +27% QoQ; active dedicated capacity adoption +9%.

Preliminary hypothesis: a shift of high-length, hosted customer traffic (some early adopters routing more inference to hosted for autoscaling) + recent kernel rollout has increased tail latency. We need both short-term mitigations (routing/fallback and canary rollback options) and mid-term fixes (batching/kv-cache changes and a targeted quantization audit for those model variants).

Attachments: 2026-08-service-pulse.pdf (dashboard), QBR draft slides (placeholder).

Requests / asks for QBR prep:
- Grace: can you own the p95 deep-dive and come back with root-cause + repro steps by EOD Mon (2026-08-17)? Include latency slices by route, length, and model variant.
- Marcus: can you scope a 2-week quantization/batching pilot and share a short plan by 2026-08-18? We'll use this to show cost upside in the QBR.
- Evelyn: please pull together the leadership deck and customer-facing highlights; I'll draft the exec summary — deck by 2026-08-19.

I want a short one-slide “what we will present” for the QBR that shows trend + root cause + 60/90 day plan. Putting Jamie Carter (NovaRetail) on the distribution — they asked for an uptime & latency callout for their account.

Thanks — Jordan

[Attachment: 2026-08-service-pulse.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: qbr-draft-slides.pptx (PPTX)]
